title: W5 T -- Hover crawl: scroll footer-covered controls into view
description: Test-only fix. tests/hover-emphasis.spec.ts:99 crawl fails since C2 added the Settings 'Floating sidebar and research' row (~35 px shift): the Settings Goal scope dropdown sits at y 862-900 under .pane-footer, elementFromPoint returns the footer, hover never lands; the crawler only scrolls when y+h > viewport. Fix: before hovering, if elementFromPoint(centre) is not the target (or inside it), scrollIntoView({block:'center'}) and re-measure. Prove: fails on the current tree (cur), passes after; the wave-4 HEAD baseline still passes. Evidence: node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui5-c3r/cur-pw.log, base-pw.log, probe-pw.log. EVERY build/Playwright run takes the serial-check.lock; private port; no src/ edits.
